title: Invariance of logarithmic plurigenera and adjoint volumes in Kähler families
summary: We consider smooth proper families of compact complex manifolds over a disk whose total space is Kähler, together with a boundary divisor with relative simple normal crossings. We prove that, if the boundary is a rational divisor with coefficients in $[0,1)$, every logarithmic pluricanonical form on a fiber extends to a neighborhood of that fiber, and hence that the logarithmic plurigenera are constant.
